**Status:** No dispute has been opened. I told the customer that opening one is irreversible and asked them to reply "yes" to confirm the EUR 240.00 goods_not_received dispute on TX-0401. Waiting on that confirmation.

**Relevant process notes:**
- Review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business days for transfer reason codes. The payment method for TX-0401 is not recorded in this conversation, so confirm which applies. Foreign-acquirer cases may take up to 45 calendar days, and the customer must be notified if so.
- The customer can withdraw the dispute any time before resolution. Withdrawal is final, and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
- Each state change generates a notification to the customer. Notifications name the state, not the internal reason for a decision.
